The '''Thul Palace''' was the palace of [[House of Thul]] located in the [[Kaamos Territory]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3643 BBY]], [[Cedarik Killesa]] tried to attack the palace through an underground passage.<ref name="Traitor">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|Traitor|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>
